title: Stratton forms the UAP Task Force

tellings.quote: I think Stratton was former Navy maybe as well and he formed the whole UAP task force which was basically like let's internally review all of the data here.

plain: In 2020 a defence intelligence official named Jay Stratton is said to have set up the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group whose job, in Michels's words, was to "internally review all of the data" on UAP, the government's term for UFOs (unidentified anomalous phenomena). Michels tells this himself, unsure of some details, saying Stratton was "former Navy maybe." It matters because it would mean someone inside the government decided the reports deserved a serious look.
